Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE crisp, polished full-screen desktop Niaro web application concept, 1536x1024 landscape. This is a reviewable product UI design, not marketing, not a mood board or laptop mockup. Reference 1 is the existing Niaro dark web shell: preserve its sidebar proportions, Manrope-like typography, graphite surfaces and restrained hairlines. Reference 2 is the EXACT existing Niaro pet: preserve translucent lavender water body, nine soft cookie lobes, glossy dark oval eyes, tiny smile, muted coloured ink inside; do NOT invent a different mascot. Reference 3 is the exact approved Niaro logo; keep its silhouette and happy negative-space face exactly when placing it as a small monochrome mark. Use reference pet without a halo or stage glow; it should blend into the dark #141518 canvas.
Page purpose: the signed-in member reviews what Niaro knows about them, understands sources and corrects it, with their pet nearby. Exact UI copy in English, use short clear lines and very legible typesetting. Synthetic user Alex Novak, workspace Studio.
Existing app shell: ~236px sidebar #0b0c0e, main #141518, surface #1b1c20, border #303137, primary #7d98f0, text #ececef / muted #9b9ea6. Small approved logo beside Studio at top, workspace sublabel Workspace. Sidebar same ordered items: Overview, New chat, Search, gap, Tasks, Meetings, Processes, Skills, Connections, Pet selected, gap, Recent, Project review, Weekly planning. Bottom Alex Novak account. Outline lucide-style icons only. No extra icons or headings.
Main page header x~292 y~64: 'You and Niaro' in 24px semibold; far right simple gear icon Settings and overflow menu. Below open two-column composition, a 700px memory document on left and quiet 260px pet rail on right, with wide whitespace. No dashboard card grid, no large wrapping cards. At top left a row 'Use memory' with small on switch aligned right.
Left content:
'About you' section, small ghost pencil action right. Two clean label/value rows 'Job title' / 'Product designer' and 'Department' / 'Studio'. Tiny quiet metadata 'Confirmed by you'. Hairline divider.
'Saved by you' section with one unboxed row: 'Keep replies short and practical.' and muted 'Preference' then trailing three-dot action.
'Observed' heading then compact outline segmented control 'Work' selected / 'Personal'. Below a sparse editorial list, category label and statement, no colored category pills.
Style: 'You prefer a short summary with next steps.' Trailing chevron and three dots. This observation is expanded below it on a subtly inset, unboxed area showing 'From chat' as a link, '24 Oct' at right, then source snippet 'A short summary and next steps is enough.' and small 'Correct' action. Muted line 'Last seen yesterday'. The source detail is quiet and legible.
Projects: 'You are preparing the Studio website.' Trailing chevron and three dots.
Tools: 'You use Figma for interface work.' Trailing chevron and three dots.
No source counts, memory score, growth meter, confidence percentages, permanent warnings, extra explanatory prose.
Right rail: precise existing pet at about 220px rendered size, generous space, label 'Bublina', secondary outline button 'Appearance'. Under a subtle gap a single neutral link 'Memory settings'. This rail is companion presence, not a giant hero.
All primary content fits this viewport with balanced whitespace. Body 14px, labels 12px, airy 64px rows, 8px control radii, thin borders, no shadows on panels, no giant rounded cards, no glow. Keep all true UI text and controls visually code-native. No health, streaks, affection points, marketing copy, extra dashboards. Render one real coherent screen, pixel-crisp and easy to inspect.
